questions.q: What is the primary objective of the 'PM-PRANAM' scheme which saw increased fund allocation this October?
questions.explain: It's all about soil health. By incentivizing states to reduce chemical fertilizer use, the government is trying to restore the health of our farmland.

questions.q: The Nobel Prize in Medicine 2025 was awarded for breakthroughs in which field?
questions.explain: This year, the committee recognized the discovery of MicroRNA. It's a huge step forward in understanding how our genes are regulated, which is vital for treating diseases.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which Indian state launched the 'Ladli Behna 2.0' scheme, expanding the scope of financial assistance to women?
questions.explain: Maharashtra rolled this out recently, building on the success of similar models. It's aimed at providing direct financial support to women to help with their household expenses.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The 'Bilateral Maritime Exercise' involving the Indian Navy and the French Navy in the Indian Ocean is known as:
questions.explain: Varuna is the name of our longstanding maritime partnership with the French. It’s a key drill that keeps our navies working smoothly together.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: India's first commercial space station module is expected to be launched by ISRO in partnership with:
questions.explain: ISRO is teaming up with Axiom Space for this. It's a bold move to get India's foot in the door of the global orbital station market.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which company became the first Indian entity to be included in the 'Global ESG 100' index this year?
questions.explain: Adani Green Energy made the cut because of their massive shift toward renewable energy assets, which caught the eye of global ESG rating agencies.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is the name of the new digital platform launched by the Ministry of Education to help students find scholarships?
questions.explain: Vidya-Samiksha Kendra is actually a broader initiative, but they've added a specific scholarship portal under it to make sure no student misses out on financial aid.

questions.q: Which country is hosting the COP30 climate summit in November 2025?
questions.explain: Brazil is taking the lead for COP30. It's a crucial meeting because it's happening right in the Amazon, putting the spotlight directly on rainforest preservation.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The 'Right to Disconnect' policy, which gained traction in several Indian corporate offices this month, relates to:
options: Mandatory power cuts for energy saving
Employees ignoring work communication after hours
questions.explain: It's all about work-life balance. More companies are adopting this to stop the 'always-on' culture and let employees actually switch off when the workday ends.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Who is the current President of the International Court of Justice (ICJ)?
questions.explain: Nawaf Salam is the one presiding over the ICJ right now. He's a seasoned diplomat who has a very tough job navigating the complex legal disputes coming his way.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: As India celebrates the 156th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi today, which global initiative focusing on 'Clean Energy Transition' has India recently launched in partnership with the UN?
questions.explain: It's a big day! To honor Bapu’s philosophy of sustainable living, India launched the Green Growth Alliance. Think of it as a way to help developing nations switch to cleaner energy without breaking the bank.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Reserve Bank of India has recently introduced a new framework for 'Digital Rupee' (e-Rupee) interoperability with which existing system?
questions.explain: You know how we use UPI for everything? The RBI has finally made it possible to link your e-Rupee wallet directly with UPI, making digital currency as easy to spend as the money in your bank account.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which country successfully hosted the 2025 Global Summit on Artificial Intelligence Ethics, held in late September?
questions.explain: Canada took the lead here. With AI moving so fast, they hosted experts from around the world to ensure we have some guardrails in place so technology serves humanity, not the other way around.

questions.q: Who was recently appointed as the new chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) in India?
questions.explain: Justice Khanwilkar took the chair recently. It’s a key role, especially since the NHRC is our primary watchdog for ensuring fundamental rights are protected across the country.

questions.q: The Nobel Prize in Medicine for 2025 was awarded for a breakthrough in which specific field?
questions.explain: This year, the committee recognized the incredible work in stem cell regeneration. It's a game-changer for treating chronic injuries that we used to think were permanent.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: In the ongoing India-Australia Test series, which Indian bowler crossed the 500-wicket mark in international cricket?
questions.explain: Our very own Jasprit Bumrah reached this elite milestone. Considering he's a fast bowler, hitting 500 wickets is absolutely massive for his career and Indian cricket history.

questions.q: The 'Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0' recently entered a new phase. What is the primary focus of this new urban phase?
questions.explain: While we've made great strides, clearing those massive, old trash mountains—the 'legacy dump sites'—is the main target now to reclaim land and improve air quality in our cities.

questions.q: Which space agency is currently preparing for the 'Lunar Base Alpha' project in collaboration with ISRO?
